restart.mainAndWelcomeDocuments: Retain exact authored text, marks and inline identities across a normal application restart.
restart.attachmentTray: Unsent ordinary files, directories and pasted-text cards belong to the running renderer; their tray membership is not restored after restart.
restart.submittedAndQueuedAttachments: Retain attachment identities and stored content through their durable message or queue metadata.
restart.coldMediaAdmission: The first queued attachment request waits for validated saved-history scope without activating its provider; deleted, private, invalid or retired owners cannot acquire that scope.
restart.sideChats: Local side chats are ephemeral; no durable side draft restoration is promised.

archive.currentInput: Retire the archived chat's draft, recall and live or cached attachments without recreating them during navigation.
archive.welcomeInput: Restore the independent welcome document and attachment tray without overwriting either with archived input.
archive.lateResult: An archive completion for another chat cannot clear the newer visible input or its deferred intent.
archive.refusal: Keep both owners' input when the host refuses archive.

focus.idleEscape: Inside an idle input, Escape releases editor focus. A later outside Escape returns to the remembered connected visible composer, falling back to the primary input.
focus.boundaries: Keep composition, consumed events, modal menus, unresolved approvals, terminal/address fields and independent message editors with their existing key owners.
